confirm.description:
Add {name}?

Smart Shades 3 motors advertise no name, so they are identified by their Bluetooth address. Use the Identify button afterwards to make the motor beep if you need to tell two apart.

user.description: Choose a Smart Shades 3 motor. Only motors currently in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed.

abort.no_devices_found: No Smart Shades 3 motors found. Wake the motor with the pinhole button on its underside and make sure it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Smart Shades 3.

jog.name: Jog motor
jog.description: Run the motor for a fixed time, then stop. Used to reach the true top and bottom while setting travel limits. Only works while the shade is uncalibrated — once limits are saved the motor ignores raw jog commands.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Which way to run the motor.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long to run before stopping. Keep this small: an uncalibrated motor has no end stops, so this duration is the only thing limiting travel.
